message.content: {"window_id":"w0015","observed_failures":[{"id":"OF1","field":"total_amount","filename":"074.jpg","observed_value":"702.00","failure_mode":"wrong_amount","evidence":"Trajectory debug shows OCR variants produce 'Total incl. of GST 102.00' and 'Subtotal : 102.00', but variants 0 and 1 also contain a garbled 'Total Amt Rounded ——S«702.00' / 'Total inel. of GBT 702.00' line. Priority-tier voting selects the final 'Rounded Total' line via last-candidate preference and returns 702.00 instead of 102.00. Image confirms final rounded total is 102.00."},{"id":"OF2","field":"total_amount","filename":"077.jpg","observed_value":"23.26","failure_mode":"wrong_amount","evidence":"Image shows receipt with 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26', 'Rounding Adj: -0.01', 'TOTAL: 23.25'. The prediction returned 23.26 (the pre-rounding total). The task says to prefer the final/rounded total; the last 'TOTAL:' line (23.25) should win over the earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST):' line."},{"id":"OF3","field":"total_amount","filename":"078.jpg","observed_value":"","failure_mode":"empty_string_instead_of_null_and_missed_value","evidence":"Image clearly shows 'Total : 92.80' and 'Grand Total : 92.80'. Default OCR variant yields tier-3 value 92.80, but combined voting across upscaled variants 1/2 where 'Grand Total' line lost its number promoted a fallback tier-0 'Grand Total' → next-line 'Cash Received 100.00' to value 100.00, and prediction_present row shows an empty string instead of null. Two defects: (a) fallback to adjacent non-excluded line can pick up CASH/payment amounts because 'CASH RECEIVED' is not in the exclusion list; (b) missing values are serialized as '' not real nulls."},{"id":"OF4","field":"date","filename":"034.jpg","observed_value":"2018-08-09","failure_mode":"wrong_date_month_day_swap","evidence":"Image shows 'Date: 09/03/2018' (and the printed invoice marker A03/1 corroborates March). Prediction parsed it as 2018-08-09, indicating the DD/MM/YYYY date 09/03/2018 was interpreted as MM/DD or OCR read '03' as '08'. Trajectory also shows an alternate OCR variant read the date as '09/08/2018'. The current date pipeline accepts the first regex hit without disambiguation or cross-variant voting on the date."},{"id":"OF5","field":"total_amount.serialization","filename":"ALL","observed_value":"\"\" for 078.jpg","failure_mode":"null_written_as_empty_string","evidence":"Row for 078.jpg in the delivered predictions has total_amount='' (empty string) rather than a real null cell. Candidate xlsx skill already warns this fails line-by-line grading; the agent's write path is not coercing None to a real null."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"RC1","summary":"Multi-variant OCR voting conflates OCR noise with real receipt content for totals.","detail":"The explicit_method_draft image-ocr skill describes a single-pass priority/exclusion pipeline, but the agent implemented a 3-variant (default / autocontrast / 2x upscale) voter with a 'prefer last keyword candidate, then fall back to next non-empty non-excluded line' rule. Upscaling frequently mutates digits (e.g., 86.17→688.17, 102.00→702.00, 92.80→100.00 via fallback to CASH line). Neither the current image-ocr nor xlsx SKILL gives guidance on how to combine variants, so the agent invented a brittle rule.","related_failures":["OF1","OF3"]},{"id":"RC2","summary":"Exclusion list is incomplete for payment/tender lines, so fallback-to-next-line leaks CASH/VISA amounts.","detail":"image-ocr lists EXCLUSIONS = ['SUBTOTAL','SUB TOTAL','TAX','GST','SST','DISCOUNT','CHANGE','CASH TENDERED']. The fallback 'if keyword line has no number, use last number on next non-empty non-excluded line' then accepts 'Visa RM =688.17', 'Cash Received 100.00', etc., because 'CASH', 'CASH RECEIVED', 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'PAYMENT', 'CARD', 'TENDERED' (alone), 'ROUNDING' are not listed. The two-line fallback described in the task is intended for keyword-and-number-split layouts, not for jumping over the number line into payment lines.","related_failures":["OF1","OF3"]},{"id":"RC3","summary":"No preference for the final 'rounded/net' total when multiple same-tier totals appear.","detail":"image-ocr defines a single tier for 'TOTAL', 'AMOUNT', 'NET TOTAL', 'NETT TOTAL', 'TOTAL DUE', etc., and picks the last candidate in reading order. When a receipt prints 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' then 'Rounding Adj: -0.01' then 'TOTAL: 23.25', last-in-reading-order will usually be correct, but when the preprocessed OCR reorders or the final 'TOTAL:' line is garbled, the earlier Inclusive line wins. There is no explicit sub-ordering such as 'prefer ROUNDED/NET/FINAL TOTAL over INCLUSIVE/SUB totals when both are in the same tier, and prefer the last keyword hit in document order within a file'.","related_failures":["OF2"]},{"id":"RC4","summary":"Date parsing is ambiguity-naive and does not use multi-variant agreement.","detail":"image-ocr's DATE_PATTERNS tries %d/%m/%Y first and returns the earliest regex match; it does not vote across OCR variants, does not detect when the same visual date is read differently (e.g., '09/03/2018' vs '09/08/2018'), and does not prefer a date that appears near explicit 'Date:' / 'DATE:' / 'Invoice Date' markers. Multi-variant date voting exists in the agent's draft code but not in the skill guidance, so the next run can regress.","related_failures":["OF4"]},{"id":"RC5","summary":"xlsx strict-schema contract is documented but the agent's writer still emitted empty string for a null total.","detail":"The explicit_method_draft xlsx skill has a strong Strict-Schema section telling the writer to convert None/NaN to real nulls, cast total_amount to object dtype, and verify by re-reading. Despite this, the delivered row for 078.jpg has total_amount=''. The skill's canonical pattern is correct, but it does not forbid the common 'pd.DataFrame.fillna(\"\")' or openpyxl 'cell.value = \"\"' anti-patterns, nor does it include a post-write assertion that every None stays as a Python None (not '' or 'nan') when re-read.","related_failures":["OF5","OF3"]},{"id":"RC6","summary":"Budget/termination pressure amplified brittle heuristics.","detail":"Source run hit max_iterations (65) with termination_reason='max_iterations' after many debug cycles tweaking regex/voting. The skills do not guide the agent to (a) stop expanding OCR variants once marginal returns are negative or (b) prefer a small, well-exclusion-covered single pipeline over ensembling. This structural gap caused the agent to keep adding variants that introduced the 074/078 regressions.","related_failures":["OF1","OF3"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion list is too narrow: missing CASH (standalone), CASH RECEIVED, CARD, VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CREDIT, PAYMENT, TENDER, TENDERED, ROUNDING, ROUNDING ADJ, SERV(ICE) CHARGE, BALANCE, POINTS. Two-line fallback should also treat payment/tender lines as exclusions.","evidence_refs":["RC2","OF1","OF3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority tiers do not distinguish final-rounded totals from inclusive/subtotal-like totals. No explicit ordering such as: GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM / ROUNDED TOTAL / NET TOTAL / NETT TOTAL / TOTAL AMOUNT > TOTAL (INCLUSIVE OF GST) > TOTAL (EXCLUDING GST) > bare TOTAL/AMOUNT, and no 'prefer the last keyword hit within the same tier, excluding keyword hits that are clearly summary/section-start lines (e.g., 'GST SUMMARY')'.","evidence_refs":["RC3","OF2"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance for combining multiple OCR variants. The skill should either (a) prescribe a single robust pipeline (grayscale + autocontrast + --psm 6, optional 2x upscale only when first pass fails) or (b) specify a safe voting rule: vote on the extracted (tier, value) pair, require agreement from ≥2 variants before overriding the default-pass result, and never allow a lower-priority variant to upgrade the tier.","evidence_refs":["RC1","OF1","OF3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback is unbounded and symmetric. It should (a) restrict to the immediately next non-empty line, (b) require that line to contain a monetary token (digits with 2 decimals or comma-grouped), and (c) skip the fallback entirely if the keyword line itself contains any digits at all (partial OCR noise).","evidence_refs":["RC1","RC2","OF1","OF3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction lacks (a) anchor-keyword preference ('Date', 'Invoice Date', 'Tarikh', 'Print Date' etc.), (b) cross-variant agreement when multiple OCR passes are used, and (c) ambiguity handling for %d/%m vs %m/%d (e.g., when day>12 is unambiguous, lock the format for the rest of the file; when both are ≤12, prefer the format that is consistent with other receipts in the batch and with any nearby month name tokens).","evidence_refs":["RC4","OF4"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"The skill does not require returning strings already formatted to the task's contract (2-decimal string, ISO date) and does not say to strip trailing/leading whitespace, currency prefixes, or decimal commas before formatting. The current regex already handles thousands separators but the skill text does not say 'remove any non-digit, non-dot, non-comma, non-minus characters adjacent to the number before conversion'.","evidence_refs":["OF1","OF5"]},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Strict-Schema section does not include a MANDATORY post-write re-read assertion that every intended-None cell reads back as a real null (pd.isna) and not '' / 'None' / 'nan'. It should also explicitly forbid df.fillna('') and openpyxl assignments of empty strings for missing values, and recommend pd.NA / None with object dtype.","evidence_refs":["RC5","OF5"]},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Strict-Schema canonical pattern does not call out that total_amount must come from the extractor as a str or None (never float, never NaN) and that an upstream bug producing '' should be caught at the DataFrame boundary (e.g., df.replace({'': None}) before to_excel).","evidence_refs":["RC5","OF5"]},{"skill":"image-ocr + xlsx (process guidance)","defect":"Neither skill tells the agent when to stop iterating on OCR heuristics. Given a fixed iteration budget, the skill should prescribe: 'if the first full pass produces an output that passes the Strict-Schema contract (valid shape, valid types, every non-null total matches /^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$/, every non-null date matches /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/), stop and ship; only iterate if the self-check fails.' This would have prevented the 074/078 regressions introduced by late ensembling.","evidence_refs":["RC6"]}],"repair_recommendations":[{"id":"R1","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSIONS to include: 'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST', 'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH RECEIVED', 'CASH', 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'MASTER CARD', 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT', 'CARD', 'PAYMENT', 'TENDER', 'TENDERED', 'ROUNDING', 'ROUNDING ADJ', 'ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT', 'SERVICE CHARGE', 'SERV CHARGE', 'BALANCE', 'POINTS'. Apply the exclusion check both to the keyword line and to the next-line fallback. Document why these payment/tender lines must never become a total via fallback.","generalization_note":"This helps any receipt task where OCR noise degrades the keyword line and the next line is a tender/payment amount."},{"id":"R2","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Refine the priority tiers to: (T0) GRAND TOTAL; (T1) TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM / RM TOTAL; (T2) ROUNDED TOTAL / TOTAL ROUNDED / TOTAL AMT ROUNDED / NET TOTAL / NETT TOTAL / TOTAL (ROUNDED); (T3) TOTAL AMOUNT / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE / TOTAL DUE; (T4) TOTAL (INCLUSIVE OF GST) / TOTAL INCL. OF GST / TOTAL INCLUDING GST / TOTAL SALES; (T5) bare TOTAL / AMOUNT. Within a tier, prefer the LAST match in document order; across tiers, lower T wins. Explicitly exclude lines that are section headers like 'GST SUMMARY', 'TAX SUMMARY', 'TOTAL ITEM(S)', 'TOTAL QTY', 'TOT QTY', 'ITEM COUNT' (treat these as exclusions).","generalization_note":"Gives a stable ordering so that rounded/net totals win over inclusive subtotals even when both lines match the broad 'TOTAL' keyword."},{"id":"R3","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Specify the OCR variant policy explicitly: (a) Always start with a single default pass on the original image (no upscale). (b) Extract (tier, value, raw_line) and accept it if tier<=T3 AND value matches /^\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}$/ after stripping. (c) Only if the first pass returns None OR a T4/T5 result, run ONE additional pass with grayscale+autocontrast at --psm 6; prefer its result ONLY if it yields a strictly better (lower) tier. (d) Do NOT use a 2x upscale pass by default; upscaling is listed as optional only for images whose max dimension is <1000 px. (e) When combining variants, never allow a variant's tier to be upgraded by a later variant unless the extracted value appears in ≥2 variants.","generalization_note":"Prevents the 074/078-style regressions where aggressive upscaling corrupts digits and promotes CASH/VISA lines."},{"id":"R4","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Constrain the two-line fallback: trigger ONLY when the keyword line has zero digit characters at all (not just no 2-decimal number). The fallback line must (a) be the next non-empty line, (b) not be in the expanded EXCLUSIONS, (c) contain a token matching /^\\s*(RM\\s*)?\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}\\s*$/ anchored or as the only monetary token. Otherwise return None for that tier and continue.","generalization_note":"Keeps the useful split-line case ('GRAND TOTAL\\n 92.80') while blocking jumps to CASH/CHANGE."},{"id":"R5","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a date-extraction policy: (a) Prefer dates that are on or immediately after a line containing an anchor keyword from {'DATE','DATE:', 'INVOICE DATE','TARIKH','PRINT DATE','TRANSACTION DATE'}; (b) Try formats in this order on the anchored substring: %d/%m/%Y, %d-%m-%Y, %d.%m.%Y, %d %b %Y, %d-%b-%Y, %Y-%m-%d, %Y/%m/%d, %d/%m/%y; (c) If day>12 in a %d/%m/... candidate, lock DMY; if month token is >12 in a %m/%d/... candidate, lock DMY; (d) When multiple OCR variants are run, vote on the ISO-normalized date and require ≥2-variant agreement to override the default pass's date; (e) Return None if no anchored date is found and the only unanchored candidate is ambiguous (both parts ≤12 and no month name).","generalization_note":"Handles the 034.jpg DD/MM vs MM/DD confusion and reduces reliance on first-match-wins."},{"id":"R6","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Mandate normalization before formatting: strip leading/trailing non-digit characters adjacent to the number, remove currency tokens ('RM', '$'), remove thousand separators (','), reject negative values for totals, reject values with more than 2 decimal digits (round only if the task explicitly says so; otherwise treat 189.673 as OCR noise and either discard or re-try with a different variant). Always return total as a Python str with exactly two decimals via f'{v:.2f}' and date as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' str; return None (not '' or 'NaN') on failure.","generalization_note":"Hardens contract compliance across any monetary-extraction task."},{"id":"R7","target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Strengthen the Strict-Schema section: (a) Add an explicit rule: 'missing values MUST be written as pd.NA / None; never as empty string, \"None\", or NaN placeholder'. (b) Add the pattern df = df.replace({'': None, 'nan': None, 'None': None}) before to_excel. (c) Add a MANDATORY verification step: after writing, re-read with pd.read_excel and assert that for every column expected to contain nullable strings, every value is either None (pd.isna True) or a non-empty str matching the required regex (e.g., /^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$/ for 2-decimal strings, /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/ for ISO dates). (d) Explicitly forbid df.fillna('') and openpyxl cell assignments to '' for missing values.","generalization_note":"Prevents the 078.jpg empty-string regression on any strict-schema task."},{"id":"R8","target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'stop condition' to the Strict-Schema workflow: once the self-check passes (schema shape OK, all non-null values match required regex, filenames sorted lexicographically, row count equals input count), ship immediately and do not iterate further on extraction heuristics. If the self-check fails, iterate only on the failing rows, not on the whole pipeline.","generalization_note":"Mitigates iteration-budget exhaustion observed in source run (max_iterations=65 hit)."},{"id":"R9","target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a short 'Debug / Self-Check' section at the end that tells the agent to: (i) print the first-pass OCR for any image where extraction returned None, (ii) print the matched keyword line and the extracted token for every non-null total, (iii) sanity-check that the extracted total is <= any Cash Received / Payment / Visa amount on the same receipt (when present and parseable) — if it is greater, flag the row for re-extraction, (iv) ensure no two receipts in the batch yield identical (filename, date, total) by accident of fallback (a cheap sanity test).","generalization_note":"Makes the OCR pipeline self-auditing without peeking at any oracle values."},{"id":"R10","target_skill":"image-ocr + xlsx (cross-reference)","change":"In image-ocr, add a one-paragraph pointer: 'When used with the xlsx Strict-Schema output pattern, return extracted fields as (date: Optional[str in YYYY-MM-DD], total_amount: Optional[str with /^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$/]). Never return floats, NaN, or empty strings.' In xlsx, add the mirror pointer: 'Extractors must emit None for unknown fields; the writer must preserve None as real nulls.'","generalization_note":"Aligns the two skills' contracts so that extraction and serialization cannot drift apart."}],"confidence":{"overall":0.78,"observed_failures":0.9,"root_causes":0.8,"skill_defects":0.8,"repair_recommendations":0.75,"notes":"High confidence in the observed per-field failures (074 amount, 077 amount, 078 amount-and-null, 034 date) because they are directly supported by the trajectory debug output and the images in this window. Medium-high confidence in the root causes because the explicit_method_draft skills are available and the diagnostic trajectory shows the exact voting/fallback logic that produced the errors. Recommendations are tier-ordering and exclusion-list changes that generalize cleanly to other receipt-OCR tasks; some risk that very narrow exclusion wording could over-exclude legitimate keyword lines on unseen layouts, hence the 0.75 on recommendations."}}
